projectGoals: Self-service — Customers can check orders, pay invoices and raise support requests online, without calling the contact centre.
Fewer support calls — Routine calls to the contact centre fall by a quarter within three months of launch.
A safe launch — A pilot with a small group of customers comes first, with a tested way back if something goes wrong.
Ready teams — Support and sales staff are trained before any customer is invited.
